description: Ask a question about this store, such as what it sells, its policies, or its services.

attribution.description: Platform attribution data. Attribution is not currently supported.

context.description: Buyer context for localization and personalization.

conversation.description: Opaque conversation identifier. Multi-turn conversations are not currently supported.

ids.description: Resource identifiers for grounding. Up to 10 of this store's Shopify Product, ProductVariant, Collection or Cart GIDs are supported. A cart or collection grounds the answer in its products.

signals.description: Platform environment data. Signals are not currently supported.

meta.description: Metadata for UCP agent profile discovery.

profile.description: Agent profile URI for UCP discovery.

name: ask_business

links.description: Links to the products, variants and collections named in `ask.ids`.

messages.description: Errors or warnings surfaced while processing the tool call.
